subject.title: fix(plugins,media): keep embedding error and input file truncation surrogate-safe

question: Should this PR remain a combined embedding plus input_file fix, or should the input_file half be left to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102634 while this branch narrows to embedding?
rationale: Both PRs touch the same input_file clamp, but only this PR fixes embedding error snippets and only the other PR adds HTTP input_file regression coverage, so sequencing affects which proof survives.

options.title: Coordinate the overlap
options.body: Keep this PR open, then either rebase it after the input_file PR lands or add equivalent input_file coverage here before landing both surfaces together.

options.title: Split the fixes
options.body: Ask this PR to narrow to embedding only and let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102634 own input_file because it already carries stronger path coverage.

options.title: Land this as-is first
options.body: Accept the combined minimal patch now, then require the input_file coverage PR to rebase or be closed as superseded afterward.

recommendation.title: Coordinate the overlap
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, then either rebase it after the input_file PR lands or add equivalent input_file coverage here before landing both surfaces together.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent history in both touched paths and are the current live PR assignee.
